d: The Retail Store Manager is accountable for managing the daily store activities from administrative and operational to offering the best customer experience. S/He manages the team towards driving sales, optimizing stock performance and ensuring a proper level of training and knowledge in the store.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or any other related field.
At least 5 years of relevant experience.
r: Define, develop and implement the store operational plan as per communicated objectives aiming at exceeding sales objectives
Establish sales budgets and targets, cascade to the team and ensure individual and store targets are met
Lead and manage the daily store operational activities to deliver the highest standards of customer service and maximize sales and profitability in line with company’s objectives
Follow up on the appearance and maintenance of the store and staff to meet Apple guidelines and evaluate audit/mystery shopper reports for improvements

Ensure a proper storage, tracking and control of inventory and follow up on the merchandising and replenishment of the store while reporting any inventory related issue/opportunity to the Retail Manager
Optimize the floor coverage and prepare schedules while accounting for vacation plans and days off
Develop and maintain good working relationships with customers and back office departments securing a smooth flow of operations
Ensure the cash management policy and all other policies/procedures are implemented in the store and that cash registers are accurately reconciled
Attend to operational problems namely customer complaints, in coordination with the back office, to ensure an uninterrupted operation and achieve customer satisfaction
Conduct periodic market studies and exchange best practices and recommendations with the Retail Manager and other Store
Prepare and issue periodic reports on store performance and other metrics supporting operational decisions
Work closely with the HR Department on staffing needs and training plans
Ensure that the company’s policies and procedures are implemented/applicable at all times
Lead and coach the team cultivating empowerment and ownership
Develop capabilities and secure a solid succession plan
Conduct regular performance reviews, identify training needs and oversee development plans.

d: At Baytonia, every showroom visit is a chance to build real trust with our customers. We're looking for a Showroom Customer Service Representative with a polished approach and strong attention to detail, to give customers a smooth experience from the moment they walk in until they receive their order.
You will look after customers inside the showroom: handling their inquiries, following up on orders and feedback, and working with internal teams so customers always get clear, accurate information.
q: Experience in customer service or sales, ideally in retail or furniture
Excellent communication skills and a courteous manner with all types of customers
Ability to solve problems and handle customer concerns calmly and professionally
Comfortable with sales/CRM systems and Microsoft Office
Fluent Arabic; English is a plus
Available to work on-site in the showroom on a shift schedule
r: Welcome customers professionally and direct them according to their needs
Answer questions about products, orders, delivery, warranty, exchanges, and returns
Give clear, accurate information on company policies, delivery times, order status, and after-sales steps
Work with the sales team and refer customers to the right specialist when needed
Follow up on customer orders and make sure contact details, addresses, and special notes are complete
Contact customers by phone or other approved channels to confirm orders and share delivery updates
Receive, log, and follow up on complaints and feedback with the relevant departments until they are resolved
Coordinate with Sales, Warehouse, Delivery, and After-Sales teams for fast, accurate responses
Never share unconfirmed information about product availability or delivery dates
Keep customer records, notes, and follow-ups up to date in the system
Keep the reception area tidy and catalogs and brochures ready
Help measure customer satisfaction and raise recurring feedback to management
Follow company policies, working hours, and professional service standards

d: Join Our Team at SPARK Logistics

We’re looking for an experienced Transportation Specialist to join our Port Management & Operation team at SPARK Logistics. If you have hands-on experience in transportation planning, freight forwarding, container movements, and cross-border logistics, this is an opportunity to play a key role in supporting our logistics operations.
Ready for your next opportunity? We’d love to hear from you.

The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and monitoring domestic and cross-border transportation activities, ensuring the safe, timely, and cost-effective movement of containers, vehicles, general cargo, and specialized shipments. The role involves managing transporter coordination, shipment tracking, transportation documentation, and compliance with Saudi Arabian transportation and customs regulations while supporting operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
q: Bachelor's degree or diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Transportation, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in transportation, freight forwarding, or logistics operations.
Experience in Saudi Arabian transportation operations and GCC cross-border logistics.
Good knowledge of seaport operations, container transportation, customs transit procedures, and bonded logistics.
Experience coordinating multiple transporters and managing daily truck movements.
Knowledge of Saudi Transport General Authority (TGA) regulations and customs requirements.
Experience in automotive, breakbulk, or project cargo transportation is an advantage.
Professional certifications in Logistics or Supply Chain Management are preferred.
Good command of written and spoken English; Arabic is an advantage.
Proficiency in MS Excel, Outlook, and ERP/TMS systems.
Strong planning, coordination, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple shipments, and meet operational deadlines.
Flexibility to work according to operational and shipment requirements.
r: Plan and coordinate domestic, import, export, and transit transportation activities.
Arrange suitable trucks, trailers, and specialized transportation equipment based on shipment requirements.
Coordinate container, automotive, breakbulk, and project cargo movements.
Monitor shipment progress, truck movements, and delivery schedules to ensure timely transportation.
Coordinate cross-border shipments across GCC countries, including bonded and transit cargo movements.
Ensure compliance with customs transit procedures, border-crossing requirements, and Saudi transportation regulations.
Coordinate with transporters and service providers, obtain competitive quotations, and support transportation rate negotiations.
Monitor transporter performance, service quality, and transportation costs.
Prepare and verify transportation documents, shipment records, invoices, and related documentation.
Maintain accurate transportation records in ERP/TMS systems and prepare daily shipment status reports.
Coordinate with customers, customs authorities, ports, and internal operational teams to resolve transportation issues.
Ensure compliance with HSSE requirements, vehicle suitability, and safe cargo handling procedures.
Identify opportunities to improve transportation efficiency, cost control, and service delivery.
Perform other related duties as assigned by the line manager.
